title: Session rules
description: Game rules Session enforces for every player (design/13-player-plane-plan.md CF-4, LB-1). Server-only: never sent to clients. Session loads them from the live server manifest and keeps its compiled-in defaults, or the last good document, when a value is missing or invalid.

party.description: Limits on parties (a party is the lobby).

max_size.description: Most players a party may hold, leader included. Invites and accepts beyond it are refused.

max_friends.description: Most friends one player may have. Sending or accepting a request beyond it is refused.

names.description: Display-name rules, applied after trimming surrounding whitespace.

min_length.description: Fewest characters (Unicode code points) a name may have.

max_length.description: Most characters (Unicode code points) a name may have. Must not be below min_length; Session rejects a document where it is.

allowed_pattern.description: Regular expression (Go RE2 syntax) the whole name must match. Anchor it with ^ and $.

rename_cooldown_hours.description: Hours a player must wait between renames. 0 allows renaming at any time.

reserved.description: Names nobody may take, compared case-insensitively.

lobby.description: What a party leader may choose in the lobby before launching (design/14-launch-handoff.md §2).

settings.description: One entry per lobby setting, keyed by the setting's name as it appears in the party's settings object. A party's settings may only use these keys, each with one of its allowed values; a key the leader never set takes its default.

description.description: What the setting means, for designers and the admin UI.

allowed.description: Every value the leader may pick.

default.description: The value a new party starts with. Must be one of allowed; Session rejects a document where it isn't.
